selection_rules.exact: Only a candidate definitionally equal to the future frozen source-native proposition, or connected by an independently checked transport that binds both expressions, is exact.
selection_rules.supporting: Coxeter length, generic polynomial evaluation, simple/finite-length category APIs, Bruhat order, Hecke algebra, R-polynomial, abstract model, and conditional wrapper surfaces are classified separately and never inherit root credit.
selection_rules.placeholder: A direct or transitive sorry, admit, sorryAx, unapproved axiom, unsafe injection, oracle, bodyless declaration, or unknown terminal body is M5 for root-credit purposes.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Each negative lane binds its query/source, immutable or repository revision, observation boundary, and reopen condition; an access limitation is never interpreted as global nonexistence.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, abstract surfaces, and declarations with one terminal body receive at most one candidate identity and no duplicated proof credit.

network_policy: denied for worker replay; no clone, fetch, update, build, or moving-ref query belongs to this inventory
immutable_refresh_policy: A newly admitted source statement, changed repository or dependency pin, or concrete immutable candidate creates a new append-only inventory version and invalidates this one.
